title: Cartwise+ Membership Tenure Extension to the Pause Allowance
content:
Long-standing Cartwise+ Membership members get a tenure extension added to the pause allowance.

**Rule.** A membership with at least 18 fee charges captured on record and an enrollment date at least 18 months back gets 28 days. One with at least 12 fee charges captured and an enrollment date at least 12 months back, without meeting the first tier, gets 14 days. Any other gets 0 days.

## Truth table

| Fee charges captured on record | Enrollment date back | Tenure extension |
|---|---|---|
| 18 or more | 18 months or more | 28 days |
| 18 or more | 12 to 17 months | 14 days |
| 12 to 17 | 12 months or more | 14 days |
| 12 or more | fewer than 12 months | 0 days |
| fewer than 12 | any | 0 days |

## Evidence

- **Fee charges captured on record**: every fee charge on the membership over its whole history — first period, renewal, renewal retry and plan switch alike.
- **Enrollment date back**: the enrollment date on the membership record, counted in whole months up to today; a month is whole on the same day of the month as the enrollment date.

## Hypothetical cases

| Charges on record | Enrolled | Today | Extension |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20 | 5 March of the previous year | 5 September | 18 months back; 28 days |
| 20 | 6 March of the previous year | 5 September | 17 whole months back; 14 days |
| 17 | 5 March of the previous year | 5 September | 14 days |
| 11 | 5 March three years earlier | 5 September | 0 days |
